name: TraceFormatBench
description: Pre-registration of the TraceFormatBench main grid. The full plan is the attached file PREREGISTRATION.md, identical to the file at commit d24b1067c97bdbafe9342736983108431a33e1dc (annotated tag prereg-v1) of https://github.com/LongHuynh-vn/traceformatbench. The repository is private at the time of registration and will be made public later. Research question: when a small local LLM must name the root-cause service from a window of five distributed traces, does the way the window is written into the prompt change how often it ranks that service first, and does it matter whether a format only changes the layout of the spans or selects and aggregates them? Design: RCAEval (RE2 and RE3, Online Boutique and Train Ticket, 78 cases); six serializations of the same windows (F0 control: RCAEval span-row JSON); two local models (qwen3.5:9b, gemma4:12b); one fixed zero-shot prompt. Primary metric: T2 Acc@1 on informative windows with case-bootstrap 95% CIs. No main-grid call and no baseline run on these windows was made before this registration; prior data access is described in section 11 of the plan.
